name: Swept Masjid
summary: A low, flowing prayer hall and a sculpted minaret form one sweeping mosque silhouette.
why: The broad roof rises into a single off-center crown aligned over its doorway. Its right shoulder joins the minaret directly. The tower cap is the upper portion of the same shaft, with an attached brass finish.
risk: The flowing tower is intentionally stylized rather than a record of one mosque tradition.
reasonToChoose: You want a broad sculptural mosque instead of a compact dome-and-towers badge.
